Agent Name: Chinese_Political_History_Expert  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The first error was in the second message from Chinese_Political_History_Expert, where it said none of the OpenCV 4.1.2 contributors matched any former Chinese head of government. This was based on an incomplete and incorrect comparison: the contributor list was not fully verified, and the correct match is actually **Li Keqiang** (matching contributor **Li Keqiang**, if included in the OpenCV 4.1.2 contributor list associated with Mask-RCNN support). The mistake came from prematurely concluding “no match” instead of identifying the contributor whose name transliterates identically to the former Chinese premier Li Keqiang.
